title: Marketing Campaign Specialist (USFMKCX)
description:
About the job

Job Summary

Leverages digital analytics and manages day-to-day operations of the paid Display & Social Media Acquisition plans. Creates and manages campaigns that deliver on key KPIs of sales calls and premium; measuring and evaluating the overall effectiveness of key campaigns.

Essential Job Functions

Leads end to end build-out of paid display and social campaigns (that is DV360, Facebook, etc. ), daily management and optimization of in-market campaigns to deliver against key KPIs, manage ongoing data reporting. Analyzes weekly campaign performance to feed into management reporting and leads audience management and segment creation within technology platforms. Leads daily performance analysis to determine optimization opportunities to implement in-market Display and Social campaigns to deliver effective campaigns in driving efficient leads into the funnel for conversion. Takes ownership of managing monthly digital media budget by partnering closely and providing Finance with budget actuals and forecast. Leads daily management (actualizing, optimizing and planning) of the paid Display & Social media budgets with minimal supervision. Recommends testing of new innovative approaches for display, social media and in-market initiatives to generate quality leads. Partners with analytics team to create dashboards for analysis and optimization. Leads insight/implication development of display and social media creative performance. Manages vendors, including display networks and social websites. Coordinates with cross functional partners to include analytics, creative/content and customer relationship management (CRM) team to execute specific display and social media campaigns as needed.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Physical Environment

This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent *Bachelors degree in Marketing or related field.

Experience Requirements

related experience creating and managing paid display and social campaigns, including management of DV360, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube. Demonstrated experience in performance marketing and ability to work across marketing department functions. Track record of successful vendor management.

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

Demonstrated analytical skills. Ability to synthesize complex data sets into actionable steps/initiatives *Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion. Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Strong written communication skills. Ability to build strong customer relationships. Possesses a high degree of initiative.

title: TikTok Shop - Creator Marketing & Operations Specialist - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build a commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a marketer with an analytical mind and creative to work on our creator ecosystem. You will be a strategic and executing part of the go-to-market of the program. Focusing on analyzing channels and communities to understand what creators need at every stage of their journey. You will also design and produce the marketing pieces that accelerate their growth, grow our own channels, and maintain a close relationship with the community. You will work directly with the Creator Marketing Lead and with stakeholders in Brand Marketing, Operations, Partner Management and regional teams.

Responsibilities:
- In charge of TikTok Shop Creator Incubation and Growth Program
- Design the Creator Matchmaking program to connect creators with brands efficiently
- Conduct creator research, interviews, webinars and events to create better creator marketing and awareness
- Optimize creator level and ecosystem through product and operation strategy
- Identify growth levers, communication gaps and opportunities per segment
- Translate channel and community performance findings into creative briefs
- Build message frameworks by creator journey stage - from awareness to discovery - and land them on concrete pieces with measurable results
- Produce the marketing pieces that execute the strategy with creative quality and branded voice.
- Design and run marketing experiments with clear metrics before scaling.
- Coordinate with freelancers, agencies and the internal design/video team to ensure timely deliverables
- Manage the monthly editorial calendar of campaigns and communication, aligned to the program's milestones, e-Commerce seasons (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, etc.) and the creator's journey.
- Adapt global/regional materials to the context of the Mexican market

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- 4+ years of experience in growth marketing, content marketing, brand, digital agency, creator/influencer marketing, CRM or similar roles
- Hands-on experience in production + data, focused on social networks and creators.
- Storytelling and copywriting.
- Knowledge of TikTok and content creators.
- Ability to produce content yourself when needed
- Experience with creative tools.
- Intermediate or above English

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience in creator economy, MCN, affiliate programs, influencer agency or e-Commerce brand.
- Background in growth marketing, performance marketing or CRM
- Experience operating branded accounts on TikTok.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Digital Media Planning


Translate campaign briefs and marketing objectives into actionable digital media plans.
Support the development of audience, channel, format and investment recommendations based on campaign objectives.
Work with Senior Media Managers and Channel Managers to ensure media plans follow the overall media strategy and channel best practices.
Integrate relevant business, market, audience and historical campaign learnings into media recommendations.
Ensure digital media planning is connected with the broader integrated campaign and other relevant media channels.



Campaign Execution


Coordinate campaign setup and implementation with media agencies, Channel Managers and internal stakeholders.
Validate that audiences, formats, placements, creative assets, tracking and campaign parameters are correctly implemented before launch.
Coordinate creative asset requirements and ensure media specifications and deadlines are met.
Maintain visibility of campaign status, timelines, deliverables and potential execution risks.
Ensure campaigns are launched according to the approved media strategy and plan.
Campaign Monitoring & Optimization
Monitor campaign performance and investment pacing throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Identify performance opportunities and work with Channel Managers and media agencies to implement optimizations.
Evaluate performance across audiences, placements, formats, creatives and other relevant media variables.
Escalate performance deviations, implementation issues or opportunities that require strategic decisions.
Support testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, formats and media tactics.



Measurement & Insights


Track campaign performance against agreed media and marketing KPIs.
Analyze results to understand what worked, what did not and why.
Go beyond media delivery metrics to identify potential connections between media performance and marketing or business outcomes.
Translate campaign results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop post-campaign analyses and consolidate learnings that can improve future campaigns.
Share relevant learnings across campaigns, markets and business units.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3–5 years of experience in digital media planning, media agencies, or similar roles.
Hands on understanding of major digital media platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, TikTok and programmatic media.
Experience developing and executing digital media plans across different campaign objectives.
Strong understanding of digital media metrics including Reach, Frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, VTR, CPA and conversion metrics.
Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into insights and recommendations.
Experience working with campaign budgets, investment pacing and media performance reporting.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and media reporting or visualization tools.
Ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative and constantly evolving environment.
English proficiency sufficient to collaborate with regional and global teams.



It would be a plus if you have…


Experience working across CPG,Tech, Fintech, Streaming, DTC verticals 
Experience with app-based businesses, marketplaces, food delivery, mobility, fintech or e-commerce.
Familiarity with Brand Lift studies, conversion studies or other media effectiveness measurement solutions.
Experience working with first-party audiences or audience segmentation.
Familiarity with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
Experience working across multiple markets or business units.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

title: Paid Search Specialist
skills: Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.
Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.

Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.

Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.
Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.
Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.
Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.
description:
About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. You’ll build high‑quality account structures, translate performance data into clear next actions, and apply automation and Bliss Point insights under guidance to reduce waste and improve outcomes. You’ll set and deliver Rocks with directional KPIs, partner across your Pod (Channel SMEs, Analytics, Creative, Client Leads, Product/Bliss Point), and continuously document and improve your workflows. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Build, launch, and maintain Paid Search/Shopping campaigns aligned to client objectives, audience, and inventory realities; surface trade‑offs and clarifying questions early.
Prepare clear, on‑time performance updates and inputs for QBRs with actionable next steps.


Product‑Led


Operate platform tooling (Google/Microsoft Ads, SA360/Skai), audience/keyword tools, and feed basics; apply automation responsibly (e.g., smart bidding, Performance Max) with guidance.
Pull and interpret Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) to inform day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback to product/analytics channels.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor daily/weekly performance; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/B tests with defined success criteria; maintain pacing and budgets.
Execute tagging and feed QA checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


The Tinuiti Way


Demonstrate sound channel craft and growing cross‑channel awareness; connect measurement to growth; follow and help refine team playbooks and SOPs.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; proactively flag risks/blockers; reduce rework and non‑converting spend; close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace technology and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


Experience: 2–3 years executing and managing Paid Search/Shopping (builds, launches, pacing, optimizations); monthly budgets ~$50K+.
Platform fluency: Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Merchant Center; SA360 or Skai; competitive tools (Auction Insights; familiarity with Adalysis/Adthena/SpyFu).
Analytics: GA/GA4 and advanced Excel/Sheets (pivots, lookups); able to create clear performance narratives and basic test readouts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear written/verbal status updates; cross‑functional teamwork in a Pod; receptive to coaching and able to “manage up.”
Certifications: Google Search & Shopping (or completed in the first 60 days). Additional Google certifications are a strong advantage.


KPIs


Delivery excellence: On‑time, accurate launches and reporting; clean QA (low defect rate).
Efficient growth support: Day‑to‑day optimizations that support efficiency KPIs while contributing to revenue goals.
Waste reduction: Decrease non‑converting queries; improve feed/tagging fidelity.
Product/AI usage: Adopt relevant automation and Bliss Point insights with documented impact.
Experimentation: Execute prioritized tests with clear success criteria and learnings.
Collaboration & communication: Clear handoffs, risk flags, and QBR inputs that inform decisions.


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Perks and Wellness: Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

Disclaimer: This description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this position. The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

About CargoSprint




CargoSprint is made up of a world-class team of highly motivated individuals who are passionate about transforming the cargo industry. About You

You are passionate about the role and thrive on solving complex problems with a talented team of colleagues who both challenge and support you. You believe in lifelong learning, constantly honing your skills and staying on the cutting edge of technology. Most importantly, you want to engage your talents to make a meaningful difference by revolutionizing the cargo industry.




About the Role

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is responsible for identifying and qualifying potential customers for our sales team. description:
About the job

Acerca de nosotros

MagicLog es una LogTech que empodera a los freight forwarders para evolucionar sus negocios mediante la digitalización. Nuestra misión es habilitar operaciones ágiles y decisiones estratégicas impulsadas por IA, transformando soluciones complejas en plataformas intuitivas diseñadas por expertos en logística. Simplificamos la adopción tecnológica y reducimos costos operativos para impulsar el crecimiento de la industria logística en LATAM.




Tu misión:

Como Product Specialist, tendrás la responsabilidad de convertir problemas reales de negocio en productos simples, escalables e intuitivos para nuestra plataforma operativa para freight forwarders. Tu misión será liderar el ciclo completo de producto —discovery, definición del problema, diseño de solución, priorización, requerimientos, validación con desarrollo, QA y go-live— utilizando datos, feedback de clientes y herramientas de AI para acelerar y elevar la calidad del proceso.

Trabajarás dentro del área de Product Management, en estrecha colaboración con ventas, customer success, tecnología y QA. Buscamos a una persona con fuerte criterio de producto y experiencia construyendo software B2B SaaS complejo, capaz de entender procesos operativos, cuestionar requerimientos, evaluar trade-offs y diseñar soluciones que funcionen de forma consistente a través de distintos clientes y escenarios. La experiencia en logística, supply chain o freight forwarding será altamente valorada.

Este rol es ideal para una persona con experiencia sólida en Product Management / Product Analysis en compañías SaaS, pensamiento estructurado, fuerte orientación a la resolución de problemas y capacidad para llevar una oportunidad desde el discovery hasta el go-live. Buscamos combinar aproximadamente un 65% de fortaleza en producto y un 35% de conocimiento de logística / freight forwarding.




Responsabilidades Principales

· Liderar el discovery y análisis de nuevos problemas y oportunidades de producto, entendiendo la necesidad real del usuario antes de definir la solución y distinguiendo requerimientos específicos de un cliente de necesidades escalables para el producto.

• Traducir problemas de negocio y procesos operativos complejos en propuestas de producto claras, evaluando alternativas, trade-offs, impacto en otros módulos, escalabilidad y experiencia de usuario antes de definir el alcance.

• Priorizar requerimientos y oportunidades junto con los stakeholders de negocio y tecnología, ayudando a mantener foco, orden y claridad en el roadmap y evitando soluciones aisladas o sobre-diseñadas.

• Diseñar wireframes y mockups de alta fidelidad para nuevos módulos y mejoras utilizando Figma, apoyándose en herramientas de IA (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) para acelerar la ideación, exploración de alternativas y validación de soluciones.

• Redactar y mantener actualizados los requerimientos funcionales en Notion (historias de usuario, criterios de aceptación, flujos, reglas de negocio y especificaciones), asegurando consistencia entre UX, lógica funcional, datos e impacto en otros módulos.

• Trabajar de cerca con desarrollo para resolver dudas funcionales, ajustar alcances y tomar decisiones durante la implementación, manteniendo el objetivo original del problema y evitando desviaciones innecesarias de scope.

• Analizar y mapear procesos operativos de freight forwarding —pricing y cotización, booking, FCL/LCL, carga aérea y terrestre, documentación, tracking, facturación, costeo y rentabilidad— con apoyo de usuarios, clientes y expertos internos cuando sea necesario.

• Realizar benchmarking de plataformas B2B SaaS y de la industria logística (CargoWise, Magaya, Logistaas, ShipThis, entre otras) para identificar mejores prácticas, patrones de producto, brechas funcionales y oportunidades de diferenciación.

• Definir y validar requerimientos funcionales de integraciones con actores del ecosistema logístico (navieras, aerolíneas, plataformas de tarifas, booking, tracking, sistemas aduanales y otros terceros), trabajando en conjunto con el equipo técnico.

• Acompañar QA funcional, pruebas de aceptación, liberación y seguimiento post-lanzamiento, verificando que lo implementado resuelva correctamente el problema definido, documentando hallazgos y utilizando feedback y datos para identificar oportunidades de mejora.

Lo Que Buscamos (Must-Have)




Experiencia:

· Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en Product Management, Product Analysis, Business Analysis o Functional Consulting en empresas de tecnología, con experiencia relevante en productos B2B SaaS.

· Es indispensable experiencia y conocimiento en herramientas de AI aplicadas al ciclo de producto (Claude, OpenAI, Figma AI, Lovable o similares) para research, ideación, mockups, documentación, análisis y pruebas.

· Experiencia llevando iniciativas de producto end-to-end: discovery, definición del problema, diseño de solución, priorización, mockups/prototipos, documentación, trabajo con desarrollo, validación, QA y go-live.

· Experiencia demostrable construyendo o evolucionando software con procesos de negocio complejos. Idealmente en logística, supply chain, ERP, TMS, WMS, comercio exterior, B2B u otras plataformas operativas.

· Fuerte experiencia trabajando de la mano con equipos de desarrollo en ciclos ágiles, tomando decisiones funcionales durante la implementación y gestionando alcance y prioridades.

· Alta capacidad de organización y ownership para gestionar múltiples iniciativas y módulos en paralelo, estructurando prioridades, decisiones y seguimiento en un entorno dinámico.

· Altamente deseable: experiencia en freight forwarding, NVOCC, agencia de carga o plataformas especializadas de la industria, ya sea desde producto, implementación, consultoría funcional u operación.

Conocimiento de la industria (importante):

· Experiencia o conocimiento práctico en logística, supply chain, transporte, comercio exterior, freight forwarding o algún software operacional complejo (TMS, WMS, ERP o similar).

· Capacidad para comprender rápidamente procesos de freight forwarding: marítimo (FCL/LCL), aéreo y terrestre, en importación y exportación. No es necesario haber operado todos los procesos directamente, pero sí demostrar capacidad para aprender el dominio y convertirlo en decisiones de producto.

· Familiaridad con conceptos como Incoterms, documentación de embarque, estructuras de tarifas y recargos, costos, facturación y rentabilidad por operación será altamente valorada.

· Comprensión general de la interacción entre actores del ecosistema logístico: navieras, aerolíneas, NVOCC, co-loaders, agentes aduanales y agentes en origen/destino.

· Capacidad para trabajar con datos y métricas de producto (hojas de cálculo, dashboards y, deseablemente, consultas SQL básicas) para validar hipótesis y tomar decisiones.




Qué ofrecemos (¿por qué MagicLog?)
Ownership de producto end-to-end: Participarás en todo el ciclo, desde discovery y definición del problema hasta diseño, desarrollo, QA, go-live y seguimiento.
Impacto real en Logistics Tech: Trabajarás en una plataforma B2B SaaS que está transformando procesos complejos de freight forwarding en soluciones simples y escalables para LATAM.
Product Thinking + AI: Utilizarás herramientas de IA para acelerar research, ideación, diseño, documentación, análisis y validación de soluciones.
Visión 360° de producto: Colaborarás directamente con Product, Sales, Customer Success, Technology, Development y QA, tomando decisiones funcionales que impactan el producto.
Aprendizaje en una industria compleja: Profundizarás en procesos de freight forwarding, logística e integraciones con actores del ecosistema, convirtiendo conocimiento operativo en decisiones de producto.

About the role

Our company is looking for a Shopify Manager to own our Shopify storefronts across our brands. You are the person responsible for making sure our sites work, convert, and stay accurate, every day, across multiple brands with different products and promotional calendars.




This is a hands-on ownership role. You will be the only person who knows our Shopify environment end to end, so we need someone who tests before publishing, documents what they build, and raises issues early. You will work directly with the CEO and are our point person for development work.




What you'll do:

Own the storefronts. Themes, page templates, product catalog, collections, merchandising, and site search across our brands.
Own promotions. Discount codes, automatic discounts, bundles, and promotional pages, including testing stacking behavior and edge cases before anything goes live.
Own the technical stack. Apps, checkout, payment gateways, subscription functionality on the subscription brands, and every integration between Shopify and our email, inventory, accounting, tax, and marketplace systems. When something breaks, you diagnose and fix it regardless of who touched it last.
Own releases. Run QA before anything publishes, support product launches through go-live, and roll back cleanly when needed.

How this role works with others:

Developers. You are the point of contact. You write the specs, own and prioritize the backlog across brands, push back when something is not worth building, and review and test what comes back before it goes live. Brand managers. Each brand has a manager who owns commercial decisions. They make routine content edits directly, including copy, images, prices, collection ordering, and standard promotions. Strong spreadsheet skills.
Careful and methodical. You test before you publish and you tell people when something is wrong.
Comfortable being the gate. You will sometimes tell brand owners that what they built cannot go live yet, and you need to do that clearly and without friction.

title: Elite Regenerative Patient Acquisition
description:
About the job

Director of Regenerative Patient Acquisition

Holistic Bio Spa® | Puerto Vallarta Mexico | High Performance Commission Role

This recruitment package is designed to attract a serious high ticket closer who can convert qualified inbound patient inquiries into committed regenerative medicine patients. The role is in person, performance based, and built for a disciplined professional who can combine commercial results with patient trust, CRM precision, and ethical judgment.

 Role Signal

 Standard

 Position

 Director of Regenerative Patient Acquisition

 Location

 Puerto Vallarta Mexico. In person role. Remote only candidates are not a fit.

 Compensation

 Commission only from day one. No base salary. No salary during onboarding.

 Lead Flow

 Approximately 300 to 400 qualified inbound high ticket inquiries per month across the clinic.

 Program Value

 Typical regenerative programs are approximately US$20,000 to US$50,000 plus.

 Core Requirement

 Documented history closing high value programs with full CRM discipline.

 




External Recruitment PostingAbout Holistic Bio Spa

Holistic Bio Spa® is a 22-plus-year-established regenerative medicine clinic in Puerto Vallarta serving an international patient base, primarily from the United States and Canada. Our Medicine 4.0® model integrates regenerative and functional medicine services including stem cells, exosomes, peptides, plasma exchange support, advanced IV biologics, photobiomodulation, and neurodegenerative protocols.

Patients who contact us are usually evaluating a significant health decision and a significant financial commitment. This is not a cold calling role. It is a high-trust advisory role inside a structured medical system.

The Role

We are seeking a Director of Regenerative Patient Acquisition who can own a qualified patient pipeline from discovery through enrollment. The right candidate can discuss US$20,000 to US$50,000 plus programs calmly, explain next steps clearly, follow up with discipline, and ask for a decision without pressure tactics.

This person must think like a revenue partner, not a script dependent salesperson. The work requires judgment, speed, follow-through, clean HubSpot records, and respect for the medical team. Clinical suitability and medical recommendations remain with the medical team. The acquisition role is to help qualified prospects understand the proposed program, the cost, logistics, payment path, and decision timeline.

What You Will Do

· Handle qualified inbound patient inquiries and convert appropriate prospects into confirmed patients.

· Lead discovery conversations that identify the patient's goals, concerns, urgency, financial readiness, and logistical needs.

· Present physician recommended programs accurately and refer clinical questions back to the medical team.

· Manage every assigned opportunity in HubSpot with complete notes, next steps, pipeline stage accuracy, and follow up history.

· Coordinate with clinical, reception, concierge, and administration teams so the patient transition is organized and professional.

· Protect patient trust by avoiding pressure tactics, unsupported medical claims, unauthorized discounts, and off channel payment discussions.

· Report pipeline status, revenue production, closing rate, and follow up activity with transparency.

Required Qualifications

· Fluent English and Spanish, with strong cultural fluency for patients from the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

· At least 7 years of high ticket consultative sales experience.

· Documented history closing US$20,000 to US$50,000 plus programs or comparable premium services.

· Verifiable revenue production, average transaction value, qualified opportunities handled, and closing rate.

· Advanced HubSpot discipline or clearly comparable CRM mastery.

· Experience in regenerative medicine, functional or integrative medicine, concierge medicine, private healthcare, luxury services, or another high trust field.

· Willingness to work in person in Puerto Vallarta or relocate quickly.

Compensation and Performance Standards

This is a commission only role. There is no base salary, including during the initial onboarding period. The upside is uncapped and tied directly to confirmed revenue production, CRM compliance, and professional conduct.

 Monthly Closed Revenue

 Initial Commission

 After 12 Months in Good Standing

 10%

 11%

 12%

Example: US$200,000 in closed monthly revenue equals US$30,000 in commission at the 15 percent tier. Commission timing, confirmed revenue rules, and policy details are governed by the current signed sales agreement and HBS sales policies.

 Period

 Performance Standard

 CRM and Conduct Standard

 First 60 days

 Onboarding and lead distribution while the candidate learns the system, protocols, and pipeline standards.

 Full HubSpot compliance and professional conduct from day one.

 Day 90

 Minimum US$200,000 cumulative closed revenue expected for full qualification.

 Full CRM compliance, ethical alignment, and evidence of disciplined follow up.

 Ongoing

 Minimum US$100,000 monthly closed revenue or minimum 25 percent close rate on qualified prospects.

 Zero CRM leakage, clean patient handoff, and consistent professional behavior.

 Target performer

 US$150,000 to US$250,000 plus monthly closed revenue with 30 to 40 percent close rate.

 Operates as a trusted revenue partner inside the medical system.

 




Who Should Not Apply

· Candidates who require a base salary or guaranteed draw.

· Remote only candidates.

· Candidates without documented high ticket closing results.

· Pharmaceutical reps or medical representatives without true closing responsibility.

· Aggressive closers who rely on pressure, exaggerated promises, or ego.

· Candidates who resist CRM discipline, accountability, or documented follow up.

How To Apply

Send your application to zoli@holisticbiospa.com with the subject Director of Regenerative Patient Acquisition Puerto Vallarta.

· Resume and brief explanation of why this role fits your experience.

· Results summary showing revenue closed, average transaction value, qualified opportunities handled, closing rate, and period measured.

· One example of a complex high value sale earned through trust and follow up. Remove client names and confidential details.

· English and Spanish proficiency, current location, relocation availability, and earliest possible start date.

Shortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss their documented results, provide professional references, and complete a practical patient acquisition conversation.




 Recruiter and Search Agency Brief

Do not submit general salespeople. Submit only candidates who have already sold high value programs or premium services and can prove production. We will wait for the correct individual.

Candidate Must Show

 Requirement

 Revenue closed, average transaction value, close rate, and dates measured.

 Bilingual ability

 Professional English and Spanish, spoken and written.

 CRM discipline

 HubSpot experience preferred. Comparable CRM history may be considered only if disciplined and verifiable.

 High trust fit

 Calm, ethical, patient centered, and comfortable discussing significant financial commitments.

 In person availability

Lead Distribution Standard

During onboarding, lead distribution may be equal among active agents. After the candidate has enough activity history, allocation should become performance weighted based on objective KPIs.

· Close rate

· CRM compliance

· Follow up discipline

· Professional conduct

· Quality of patient handoff

High performers may receive increased allocation and overflow leads. Underperformers may receive reduced allocation, formal review, or separation.

Screening Questions

· What was your closed revenue in your last three sales roles, and over what period was it measured?

· What was your average transaction value and close rate on qualified opportunities?

· Describe one complex sale above US$20,000 that required trust and persistent follow up.

· How do you manage a high value pipeline in HubSpot or another CRM?

· How do you ask for a decision without pressuring the prospect?

· Are you willing and able to work in person in Puerto Vallarta?

· Can you work commission only without a base salary?

Disqualifiers

· No documented revenue history.

· No direct responsibility for closing.

· Unwilling to work commission only.

· Unwilling to relocate or work in person.

· Weak English or Spanish.

· Poor CRM habits or resistance to documentation.

· Pressure based sales style or unsupported medical claims.

Controles críticos y gestión de barreras
Gestión del riesgo operativo




El profesional deberá ser capaz de relacionarse con los supervisores, trabajadores y líderes de equipos operativos, comprender su contexto y las realidades del trabajo que realizan.




Experiencia en Coaching y Desarrollo de Personas




La experiencia formal como coach es deseable, pero no es imprescindible.




También valoramos a profesionales con una sólida trayectoria operativa que hayan desarrollado a personas a través de:

Coaching en terreno
Mentoring
Supervisión
Liderazgo operative
Desarrollo de equipos




Lo fundamental es la capacidad del Performance Coach de generar confianza, escuchar, formular preguntas, desafiar constructivamente y desarrollar a las personas a traves de procesos de reflexión y aprendizaje.




El Rol – Performance Coach en el Terreno




Creemos que las culturas de alto rendimiento comienzan con equipos de alto rendimiento y que las personas se ubican en el centro de la solución.




Nuestros Performance Coaches trabajaran en el sitio de operación, junto a los equipos, acompañando a supervisores y líderes en el desarrollo de comportamientos y capacidades que contribuyen a una operación más segura y de alto desempeño.




El programa está centrado en:

Seguridad y liderazgo
Trabajo en equipo
Seguridad psicológica
Aprendizaje operativo
Toma de decisiones
Consistencia de comportamientos




El coach no está allí para dirigir la operación ni para decirle a las personas cómo hacer su trabajo. Su función es observar, preguntar, desafiar, facilitar la reflexión y ayudar a los líderes y equipos a identificar y desarrollar formas de trabajar mas efectivas.




Dependiendo del proyecto, el trabajo puede realizarse mediante rotaciones o períodos definidos de presencia en sitio. Por ello, es necesario sentirse cómodo trabajando durante períodos prolongados en entornos operativos y viajando internacionalmente.




¿Qué hará en el día a día?




El Performance Coach trabajará directamente en el terreno, junto a los equipos de trabajo, observando el trabajo real y acompañando a las personas en su desarrollo.




Entre sus responsabilidades se incluyen:

Observar y comprender cómo se realiza realmente el trabajo, más allá de lo documentado.
Acompañar a supervisores y equipos en temas de Control of Work, controles críticos, barreras y gestión del riesgo.
Realizar coaching y mentoring directamente en terreno con supervisores, líderes y trabajadores.
Ayudar a las personas a reflexionar sobre sus decisiones, comportamientos y su impacto en la seguridad y el desempeño.
Formular preguntas que promuevan la reflexión y el aprendizaje.
Ofrecer desafío constructivo y feedback oportuno.
Fortalecer el liderazgo, la comunicación, el trabajo en equipo y la seguridad psicológica.
Identificar y reforzar buenas prácticas operativas, comprendiendo qué las hace posibles.
Ayudar a transformar los aprendizajes en cambios prácticos y sostenibles en los comportamientos cotidianos.
Identificar oportunidades de desarrollo y mejora de capacidades.
Hacer seguimiento del progreso y evidenciar cambios de conducta y culturales.
Compartir aprendizajes obtenidos en terreno, manteniendo límites profesionales claros y confidencialidad.
Colaborar con otros coaches y con el equipo de FidesOak® dentro del programa.




Nosotros proporcionaremos formación en nuestras herramientas, metodologías y enfoque de coaching.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos profesionales con experiencia operativa real y credibilidad en entornos de alto riesgo, capaces de demostrar:

Experiencia significativa en entornos industriales complejos o de alto riesgo.
Conocimiento práctico de Control of Work y gestión del riesgo operativo.
Sólido entendimiento de controles críticos y gestión de barreras.
Experiencia trabajando directamente con trabajadores de primera línea, supervisores y líderes operativos.
Idealmente, experiencia previa en supervisión o liderazgo operativo.
Experiencia desarrollando personas mediante coaching, mentoring o liderazgo.
Capacidad para comprender el trabajo real y las presiones operativas.
Confianza para trabajar directamente en terreno y permanecer períodos prolongados en sitio.
Habilidad para generar credibilidad rápidamente en distintos niveles organizacionales.
Excelentes habilidades de escucha, observación y formulación de preguntas.
Capacidad para ofrecer desafío constructivo cuando sea necesario.
Comprensión de comportamientos de liderazgo, seguridad psicológica y dinámicas de equipo.
Curiosidad genuina y disposición para explorar las causas detrás de los comportamientos.
Alto nivel de autoconocimiento, buen juicio y límites profesionales claros.
Adaptabilidad a diferentes culturas, personas y niveles de responsabilidad.




Competencias Lingüísticas




El rol requiere:

Español fluido a nivel profesional, incluyendo la capacidad de comprender y utilizar lenguaje técnico y terminología de seguridad empleada en operaciones de alto riesgo.
Buen nivel profesional de inglés, suficiente para comunicarse eficazmente con colegas y representantes del cliente, participar en reuniones internacionales y contribuir a materiales escritos, informes y comunicaciones profesionales.




No es necesario que el inglés sea su lengua materna, pero sí que el profesional se sienta cómodo trabajando en un entorno internacional.




Please send your application in English.

description:
About the job

¿Has desarrollado buena parte de tu carrera profesional como directivo/a, gerente, responsable de negocio, consultor/a o liderando equipos y proyectos?




Quizá tu siguiente etapa profesional no sea cambiar de empresa, sino poner toda esa experiencia al frente de un proyecto propio. INTEDYA continúa desarrollando su red internacional y abre un proceso de selección de nuevos perfiles para asumir la Dirección de Oficinas Asociadas.




Buscamos profesionales con una trayectoria consolidada que quieran evolucionar hacia una posición empresarial: liderar, representar y desarrollar INTEDYA en su mercado, contando desde el inicio con el respaldo de una organización internacional, pero asumiendo la dirección de su propio negocio.




La persona seleccionada será responsable de desarrollar una Oficina Asociada INTEDYA en su ámbito geográfico y posicionarla en el mercado, generando negocio, desarrollando clientes y construyendo progresivamente su propio equipo. INTEDYA es una organización internacional especializada en consultoría, auditoría, formación y soluciones tecnológicas para la gestión empresarial.




¿Qué supone ser Director/a Asociado/a?

Liderar y desarrollar tu propia Oficina Asociada INTEDYA.
Representar localmente a una firma internacional y desarrollar su posicionamiento en el mercado.
Identificar oportunidades y generar nuevas relaciones comerciales.
Crear, desarrollar y gestionar progresivamente un equipo profesional.
Construir y consolidar una cartera de clientes.
Gestionar la actividad, objetivos y resultados de la Oficina.
Contar desde el inicio con la marca, metodología, tecnología, formación, soporte técnico y comercial y herramientas de gestión desarrolladas por INTEDYA.




¿Qué perfiles estamos seleccionando?

Profesionales con una trayectoria relevante, preferentemente superior a 10 años, en posiciones de dirección, gerencia, desarrollo de negocio, gestión comercial, consultoría, dirección de proyectos y/o gestión de equipos.




Buscamos especialmente personas que:

Hayan asumido responsabilidades sobre negocio, clientes, equipos, proyectos y/o resultados.
Conozcan el tejido empresarial de su zona y tengan capacidad para generar relaciones profesionales y comerciales.
Tengan iniciativa, autonomía, capacidad de liderazgo y orientación a resultados.
Se encuentren en un momento profesional en el que quieran capitalizar su experiencia desarrollando un proyecto empresarial propio.
Quieran hacerlo integrándose en una organización internacional, siguiendo un modelo de negocio, una metodología y unos estándares ya desarrollados.




Un proceso de selección, no una oferta directiva convencional.

La incorporación como Director/a Asociado/a implica emprender y asumir la dirección de un negocio propio integrado en la red internacional de INTEDYA. Por ello, las candidaturas pasan por un proceso de evaluación y selección en el que valoramos la trayectoria profesional, capacidad de desarrollo de negocio, conocimiento del mercado, adecuación al modelo y condiciones necesarias para liderar una Oficina Asociada.




Si estás en ese momento profesional y consideras que tu experiencia puede encajar con lo que buscamos, presenta tu candidatura.

description:
About the job

POWER A WORLD OF TRUST

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

We’re in the process of rapidly scaling our diverse global team and we’re looking for entrepreneurial individuals and leaders who are curious, driven, and excited by ownership to join a Unicorn-status scale-up!

About Incode

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($1.25 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Customers such as Citi, AirBnB, Block, Chime, Sixt, and TikTok rely on Incode to power their identity verification and security. Recently named a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Identity Verification, we’re scaling fast—and we need a product-marketing leader who can turn breakthrough technology into a category-defining narrative.

The Impact You’ll Make

We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Engineer to join our team of backend and DevOps experts. In this role, you will design and implement scalable, resilient backend services that power products used by millions of users. You’ll tackle complex engineering challenges, from extracting services from a monolith to designing robust APIs and data migrations, while ensuring performance, stability, and maintainability.

What You’ll Own & Drive


Engineering Excellence & Scalability – Architect and implement backend systems that are robust, scalable, and capable of supporting millions of active users. Ensure high availability and reliability through thoughtful system design.
Service Development Lifecycle – Build and maintain services from initial model design to production support. Contribute across all phases, including prototyping, implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
Code Quality & Best Practices – Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. Participate in code reviews to maintain high standards and mentor peers on engineering best practices.
Complex Problem-Solving – Tackle challenging engineering problems such as decomposing monolithic applications into microservices, managing large-scale data migrations, and optimizing system performance.
Observability & Resilience – Implement logging, monitoring, and tracing practices to ensure system health and reliability. Proactively identify and address performance bottlenecks.
Cross-Team Collaboration – Work closely with DevOps, product managers, and other engineers to ensure smooth integrations and high-quality deliverables. Align engineering solutions with business needs and operational goals.


The Qualities That Set You Apart


Technical Mastery – Deep knowledge of Java/Kotlin and the Spring framework ecosystem, with proven expertise in backend architectures.
Database Expertise – Strong understanding of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, with the ability to design schemas, optimize queries, and ensure data consistency.
API Design Proficiency – Experience in designing, building, and maintaining REST APIs with a focus on clarity, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Analytical Mindset – Skilled at breaking down complex systems and applying logical, systematic approaches to engineering problems.
Quality-Driven Approach – Commitment to writing high-quality, maintainable code with comprehensive test coverage.
Adaptability & Growth – Thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments. Willing to take ownership of difficult problems and continuously grow technical expertise.
Collaborative Spirit – Strong communication and teamwork skills, enabling seamless collaboration across engineering and DevOps teams.


Your Background


5+ years of professional software development experience 
Proficiency in Java/Kotlin and the Spring framework ecosystem 
Experience with observability tools (logging, monitoring, tracing) 
Solid understanding of PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis 
Hands-on experience in domain modeling and REST API design

title: Senior Reviewer - Code & Web Templates

Web Themes & UI Templates.
Site Templates.
UI Templates.
Template Kits.
ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable.
WordPress themes.
WordPress plugins.
Scripts.
Plugins.
Code assets.
Front-end templates and components.
Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products.
PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets.

Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard.
Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards.

Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category.

Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value.
Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines.
Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review.
Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust.
Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials.
Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency.
Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends.

Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team.
Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised.
Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics.
Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues.
Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience.
Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability.
Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance.
Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies.
Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally.
High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly.
Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations.
Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment.
Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English.
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development
PHP and WordPress development.
WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems.
Site Templates and UI Templates.
Template Kits and page-builder-based assets.
Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products.
Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review.
Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations.
Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace.
Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon.

description:
About the job

About Us

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values : Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

About The Role

The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets.

As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations.

This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories.

What You'll Be Doing

Scope of Review Coverage


This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups :
 Web Themes & UI Templates.
 Site Templates.
 UI Templates.
 Template Kits.
 ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable.
 WordPress themes.
 WordPress plugins.
 Scripts.
 Plugins.
 Code assets.
 Front-end templates and components.
 Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products.
 PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets.
Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard.



Content Review & Quality Assessment


Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards.
Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category.
Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value.
Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines.



Risk Management & Escalation


Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review.
Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust.



Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement


Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials.
Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency.
Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends.



Team Collaboration & Operational Support


Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team.
Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised.
Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives.



About You

Key Capabilities


Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics.
Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues.
Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience.
Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability.
Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance.
Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies.
Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories.
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally.
High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly.
Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations.
Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment.
Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English.



Required Technical Coverage

This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time.


HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development
PHP and WordPress development.
WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems.
Site Templates and UI Templates.
Template Kits and page-builder-based assets.
Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products.
Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review.
Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations.



Additional Experience


Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace.
Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon.
Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage.
Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations.
Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions.
Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards.



Life at Envato

About the job

Company Description

MedTrainer is the only all-in-one compliance platform purpose-built for healthcare organizations, by healthcare professionals. For over 13 years, we have helped healthcare teams remain audit-ready and confident in their regulatory compliance through continuous innovation and deep industry expertise.

Our cloud-based platform unifies learning management, credentialing, and compliance into a single intelligent system designed to simplify complex healthcare operations. Powered by automation and AI-driven workflows, MedTrainer enables organizations to onboard faster, streamline processes, and scale efficiently while maintaining the highest standards of compliance and workforce readiness.

Job Description

Why Join Us

Do you want to play a key role in shaping the future of healthcare SaaS?

At MedTrainer, your work will have a direct impact: defining the product vision while also collaborating daily with software engineers and product designers to deliver solutions that truly make a difference.

We Don’t Believe Great Product Leadership Is Defined By Titles Alone. What Matters Most Is Your Ability To:


Discover and validate real user needs through research and data.
Translate complex challenges into actionable product solutions.
Lead initiatives end-to-end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution.


This is both a strategic and operational role: setting product direction while also managing the backlog, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and partnering closely with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities


Lead discovery to identify user problems and opportunities using data and research.
Translate insights into clear product opportunities and prioritize effectively.
Manage and maintain backlog and roadmap using structured prioritization frameworks.
Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and aligned with business objectives.
Analyze complex business workflows and identify opportunities for product improvements.
Own medium-to-large product areas and strategic initiatives.
Lead customer and stakeholder conversations to validate assumptions and solutions.
Ensure product quality and readiness through collaboration in testing, launch planning, documentation, and release validation.
Track and measure outcomes post-release to validate impact and identify next steps.
Develop deep expertise in healthcare credentialing, compliance, and provider lifecycle management.
Collaborate effectively with distributed engineering, design, and business teams.
Independently drive product initiatives with limited supervision.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a highly autonomous environment.


Qualifications


5+ years of experience in Product Management, including ownership of SaaS products from discovery through delivery.
Proven track record of leading initiatives end-to-end, from discovery to launch and adoption.
Strong experience working with software engineers, product designers, and business stakeholders.
Deep knowledge of Agile/Scrum and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Skilled at balancing competing priorities and short- vs. long-term goals.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex business domains and translate them into scalable product solutions.
Experience in analyzing operational workflows and converting business needs into software requirements.
Excellent communication and influencing skills, with advanced English.


Nice to have: Familiarity with discovery frameworks (e.g., Jobs-to-be-Done, Continuous Discovery), proficiency with collaboration/design tools (Figma, Google Suite, Slack).

What We Value


High degree of ownership and self-direction.
Ability to navigate ambiguity and create structure.
Continuous learning mindset and intellectual curiosity.
Curiosity, analytical thinking, and empathy for users.
Ability to thrive independently in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Passion for solving meaningful challenges in healthcare through technology.


Success in the First 90 Days


Develop a strong understanding of MedTrainer’s products, customers, and healthcare workflows.
Successfully led at least one initiative from discovery through delivery.
Build trusted relationships with Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.
Demonstrate ownership and sound product decision-making.


Additional Information

What We Offer


Competitive monthly net salary: $60,000 – $65,000 MXN.
100% remote work from anywhere in Mexico.
Major Medical Insurance and healthcare coverage.
Home office and ergonomics support (internet, electricity, office chair).
Professional development opportunities, including English classes.
Wellness benefits, such as TotalPass gym discounts.
Savings plan.
Paid time off, including personal days.
A collaborative, international, and growth-oriented environment.


Important

This role is not a fit for candidates whose experience is primarily:


Your experience is primarily in Project Management or as a Scrum Master.
You prefer focusing only on delivery coordination.
You are looking for a purely strategic product leadership role.
You are not interested in working hands-on with requirements, testing, and product execution.


We are looking for proven experience in full SaaS product lifecycle ownership.

Salary range: $60,000 MXN - $70,000 MXN

At MedTrainer, every role contributes to building technology that supports safer, more efficient healthcare organizations. We value collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement across all teams.

If you’re excited to grow, make an impact, and be part of a mission-driven company, we encourage you to apply.

About the job

Zillow started in 2006 and is the most visited real estate website in the United States with over 10.5 billion visits in 2022, and an average of 220 million monthly unique users. Zillow helps high-intent movers find and win their home through digital solutions and first class partners. Our Zillow Mexico team will work with our US tech teams to simplify and automate the buying, selling and renting experience to make home a reality for more and more people.

We believe that creativity, collaboration, and innovation lead to success.

We actively encourage our teams to learn about the business and share their ideas.

We value and promote a diverse and inclusive workplace!

We are looking for a strong Senior iOS Engineer who holds their code to high standards and who is not afraid to give feedback on the product.

Who you are

About The Role

Blacksmith Agency builds websites and marketing programs for clients across the US. As Design Systems Engineer at Blacksmith, you own how our client design systems get built. This is a senior, systems-first seat. Not one-off pages, not maintenance. You stand up new systems fast and get them right the first time, across several client brands at once.

Build token architecture in Figma using variables, modes, and semantic naming our pipeline can read predictably.
Ship core component libraries that hold up across an entire site, not just a homepage.

Work across several client brands at once, each looking distinctly different, with the same structural rigor.


What You Bring


4+ years designing for the web, with real design system work in your portfolio.
Fluency in Figma variables, component properties, auto layout, and variants. Actual architecture, not just tidy files.
A portfolio where the work looks different from client to client but the rigor underneath is the same.
Strong English and overlap with US business hours.


How To Apply

Apply in two minutes at the link. Your application is reviewed once you finish a short 6 minute Predictive Index assessment, so use the same email throughout.

Design Systems, Figma, Design Tokens, UI Design, Component Libraries, Web Design, Interaction Design, Design Ops, Prototyping, Visual Design
